## F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: mandatory insurance
Knowledge facts: part C holds 39 fact blocks (sec15-F01 onward) from physical pages 81 to 84; part C2 holds 16 confusable and continuation blocks (sec15-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states the issuer, the Revised August 2026 guide, the 25-question written test and the passing standard of 20 correct answers (80 percent) from physical pages 1, 3, 4 and 20; the time limit is unknown.
VERIFY list:
- MO-INS-A-TIME — written-test time limit not printed in the guide (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- MO-INS-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- MO-INS-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: the coverage minimums (sec15-F09 to sec15-F12), bond and cash amounts (sec15-F07, sec15-F08), suspension fees (sec15-F21 to sec15-F24) and the accident report form number (sec15-F38) can change, and the Move It campaign timing is tied to the guide's edition.

corpus_stability.reason: The Missouri Driver Guide prints a single edition line on its front cover (Revised August 2026); its table-of-contents note says law and policy changes may make parts out of date and points to the website for the current version, with no sign in the selected pages of more than one rewrite per year.
